headline: DeepTutor Turns Personal Knowledge Into Practice
lede: DeepTutor routes books, repositories, videos, and local files through retrieval, indexing, and source-aware answers. Its learning workspace connects grounded explanations to quizzes, mastery paths, and progress tracking, making the knowledge base an active study partner.

headline: Superpowers Brings Discipline to Coding Agents
lede: Before an agent writes code, Superpowers makes it discover requirements, validate a design, and map the work into testable tasks. The framework turns autonomous development into a sequence of plans, checks, isolated worktrees, and reviewable changes.

headline: Impeccable Gives Coding Agents Better Taste
lede: Impeccable supplies a visual vocabulary for agents building real interfaces, from typography and responsive layout to accessibility and motion. Deterministic detectors and iterative critique push generated frontends past generic cards, gradients, and boilerplate SaaS polish.

headline: ThinkRail Builds a Control Room for Agents
lede: ThinkRail organizes concurrent coding agents inside isolated Git worktrees, where plans, diffs, terminals, reviews, and CI checks remain visible. Persistent specifications and configurable skills give autonomous work an architectural spine instead of a disposable chat history.

headline: OpenMausBot Keeps the Agent Team Close
lede: OpenMausBot coordinates specialized agents from a local harness, keeping transcripts, credentials, and events on the user’s machine. A permission broker stands between automation and sensitive shell, file, or computer actions, putting consent at the center of multi-agent work.

headline: OpenBot Puts Persistent Teammates at One Desk
lede: OpenBot gathers provider CLIs, local models, browser automation, queues, and agent-to-agent messaging into a cross-platform workspace. Its isolated rooms and long-running conversations make a playful but practical experiment in coordinating a small digital crew.

headline: AI Design Skills Package Taste for Reuse
lede: This compact collection turns landing-page decisions into portable instructions for coding assistants. Each markdown skill records requirements, structure, copy, typography, spacing, and motion in a form teams can adapt, version, and carry across tools.

headline: Claude-Mem Gives Agents a Longer Night
lede: Claude-Mem captures tool activity, summarizes it, and quietly retrieves the relevant past when a new session begins. Its local worker, SQLite store, and hybrid search let an agent resume a project’s reasoning without forcing the developer to retell it after dark.

headline: OpenBot Gives AI Coworkers a Governed Workplace
lede: CopilotKit’s OpenBot provides self-hosted agents with browsers, files, credentials, and approved tools inside dedicated virtual workspaces. A central gateway records actions and routes permissions, giving organizations an extensible platform for automation that remains auditable and interruptible.

headline: Jailbreaks Maps the Instruction Attack Surface
lede: This collection assembles model-specific prompts, policies, personas, and Modelfiles that alter how more than 25 systems behave. For defenders and evaluators, the files form a practical test bench for instruction conflicts, prompt injection, and the fragile boundaries of agent configuration.
